author: Bay State News
title: Three UMass Lowell lacrosse players receive America East All-Conference honors
text:
The University of Massachusetts Lowell men’s lacrosse team had three players named to America East All-Conference teams, according to an April 29 announcement from the conference.
This recognition highlights the achievements of juniors Johnny Soi and Justin Alexander, who were selected for the America East All-Conference Second Team, and freshman Ryan Proctor, who was named to the conference’s All-Rookie Team.
Head Coach Drew Kelleher said, “Juice (Justin) and Johnny are both really hard workers who are helping drive the team. I’m so proud of them being honored by the league, and I can’t wait to get back to work with them next fall. Ryan has done a great job in his first year here, and we’re excited to watch him grow.”
Soi finished his third season ranking third on the team with 15 goals and 19 points. He recorded a career-high five points in a win over Wagner early in the season. Alexander posted a faceoff win percentage of 61.2 across 12 games, which placed him eleventh nationally. He also averaged eight ground balls per game and contributed offensively with one goal and two assists.
Proctor made an impact as a freshman by scoring in his first two games and ending the season with eleven goals and three assists for fourteen points. His top performance came during conference play at NJIT where he achieved his first career hat trick.
